question: Which of the following players won the orange cap in IPL - 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shubman Gill.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Shubham Gill won the **orange cap** in IPL - 2023.
 
• Shubman Gill is a cricket player from** India**.
 
• In addition to playing for Punjab in domestic cricket and the Gujarat Titans in the Indian Premier League, he is an **international representative** of the Indian cricket team.
 
• Gill was named** Player of the Tournament** during the 2018 **Under-19 Cricket World Cup**.
 
• The **Orange Cap** is awarded to the player who scores the most runs in an IPL season. It is a prestigious award in the tournament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ten franchise teams **from cities around India compete in the men's Twenty20 (T20) cricket league known as the Indian Premier League (IPL).
 
• In **2007**, the **BCCI **established the league.
 
• The Indian Premier League was the first sports event to be streamed live on YouTube in **2010**.
 
• Every year, the competition is typically held in the summer, between **March and May**. 
 
• **Yashasvi Jaiswal **is a young Indian batsman who made his IPL debut in** 2020 for Rajasthan Royals.**
 
• **Faf du Plessis** is a South African cricketer who has played for **Chennai Super Kings in IPL.**
 
• **Devon Conway** was hired by the **Chennai franchise** for Rs. 1.00 Cr. during the IPL 2023 Auction.
